```yaml
name: Repo Commands

on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [repo-command]

jobs:
  handle-command:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Parse command
        id: parse
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const command = github.context.payload.client_payload?.command;
            console.log(`Command received: ${command}`);
            return command;

      - name: Run /makerelease
        if: steps.parse.outputs.result == '/makerelease'
        run: |
          echo "Running make release..."
          npm ci
          npm run build
          npm run release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Commit changes
        if: steps.parse.outputs.result == '/makerelease'
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: "chore: release via /makerelease command"
          add: "."
          push: true
          cwd: "."
          default_author: github_actor

      - name: Trigger release workflow
        if: steps.parse.outputs.result == '/makerelease'
        uses: benc-uk/workflow-dispatch@v1
        with:
          workflow: release.yml
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: main
```
